noun_definition: Web refers to the online environment in which the app operates, specifically highlighting the absence of a back button in the personal details section when the app is accessed in offline mode.
Profile refers to the section within the app where a user can view and manage their personal details.
Back button refers to a navigational element that should be displayed on the personal details page of the app while loading in offline mode, allowing users to return to the previous screen.
Personal details refers to the section of the app's profile settings that displays user-specific information, which is accessed while the app is in offline mode.
offline mode refers to the state in which the app is used without an internet connection, affecting the display of navigation elements like the back button on the personal details page.
